title: Supersede the stale image guidance in eos-mini
prompt: The guidance file doctrine/mini/guidance/IMAGES.md still tells pages to serve a single fixed-width JPEG, but WG-MINI-002 ruled for responsive AVIF or WebP variants and the module doctrine cites that ruling. Retire the stale guidance the governed way: write the replacement guidance citing the ruling, link old and new with the supersession rule in GOVERNANCE.md, regenerate the derived indexes, and leave python tools/eos_check.py --repo reporting zero errors.

criteria.desc: Old and new guidance are linked bidirectionally and the stale claim is no longer active

notes: Runs against the eos-mini fixture, whose checker is a byte-for-byte copy of tools/eos_check.py. The stale sentence is the JPEG fixed-width line planted in IMAGES.md; WG-MINI-002's ruling contradicts it and was argued twice. Deleting IMAGES.md fails c1: supersession keeps history in place.
